note: In-process 120 Hz samples of the presentation layers of AppKit (SwiftUI-hosted) controls in the probe, light mode, macOS 27.2.1. t = seconds after the synthetic mouse-down. Only samples that differ from the previous one are kept. Layers: c class, f frame (pt, control-local), bg/fill sRGB-extended rgba, op opacity, r corner radius. LiftLayer = pressed knob; its SDFLayer child is the glass lens (op = glass share, the white CALayer op = 1 - glass share).

events.what: switch long press 900 ms on, release toggles off
switch press+drag 30 pt over 300 ms, release
slider click on track 70 pt right of knob (jump)
slider drag knob -120 pt over 500 ms
segmented press seg 1, drag to seg 3, release
